Your connection needs attention
Instagram’s sign-in page could not load. Sign-in is not complete. Check your connection or look for security alerts in Instagram. Do not keep submitting your password.
Instagram is checking your sign-in. A result should appear within about 35 seconds; do not submit again.
Signed in. After the short request interval, your profile will be checked once to complete the connection.
Signed in. Use A to check the browser reader, then B to compare the app reader.
Instagram requires an extra security check; sign-in is not complete. Open verification below instead of sending your password again.

Instagram requires a CAPTCHA / security check. This version could not open the verification step in the response, so sign-in is not complete and the form was closed. This does not establish that your password is wrong. Tap Check in Instagram and complete any security check shown there yourself. That does not automatically connect Tracker. Try once again after the time below.

Instagram requires additional verification. Enter the requested SMS or authenticator code in the Instagram page below, or approve the sign-in in Instagram if asked. Do not send the code in chat. If no code field or approval step appears, do not resubmit your password; cancel and check security alerts in Instagram.
Instagram did not create a session for this single attempt. The form was closed; no additional credentials were sent. The response alone does not establish the underlying cause.
Instagram sign-in was not completed
No new sign-in was sent from this screen. The previous attempt does not verify other accounts’ credentials. Wait until the time below before trying again.
Try the app reader directly
Show Instagram verification

This opens Instagram’s security page. Meta’s CAPTCHA frame and Google reCAPTCHA may load and receive your IP address and browser information. The app does not forward your password or Instagram session to these domains. Complete verification yourself; cancelling leaves these resources blocked.
Complete Instagram’s security step on this page. After success, your profile will be checked. If the page does not continue, finish verification and tap Verify account once.
